documents.title: Statement on Responsible and Acceptable Use of Artificial Intelligence
documents.quality_note: Campus statement on responsible AI use with data-handling rules for sensitive data and pointers to the U of I System student/instructor guidance; mostly principles and links, little classroom policy.

documents.title: Generative AI resources and guidance for faculty
documents.quality_note: Provost message to faculty on AI in teaching and research; older (2023) but the official provost voice. Mix of guidance and resource links.

documents.unit: Center for the Advancement of Teaching Excellence (CATE)
documents.title: Teaching Guide: AI Writing Tools
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center guide with advice on setting course AI policy and prohibit/limited/encourage syllabus statement examples.

documents.title: Graduate Degree Requirements, Department of Computer Science, 2025
documents.quality_note: AI text is two short passages in a 100k-char handbook: the Academic Integrity 'Non-original work' standard (generative AI to improve writing, grammar and fluency, 'is not forbidden a priori, but may be further restricted in specific classes') and the WCP rule (an initial draft prior to AI use must be available to the committee). Graduate students only.

documents.title: Graduate Degree Requirements, Department of Computer Science, 2023
documents.quality_note: Earlier edition, probably superseded by 2025. States: 'you should not use paraphrasing software (like QuillBot) or AI software for writing (like ChatGPT) or any AI tools for content generation (spell-checkers are allowed), unless explicitly allowed to do so.' Repeated in the WCP rules. Shows the stance changed between editions.

notes: Seed known URL (CS 218 Fall '25 syllabus, Google Sites) is a course document; course layer deferred, so not collected. U of I System EVPAA 'Generative AI Guidance for Students/Instructors' (vpaa.uillinois.edu/digital_risk_management/generative_ai/students and /instructors) returned a Cloudflare challenge ('Just a moment...') to fetch_text.py, so they are inaccessible; they are System-level, referenced by the UIC IT statement. UIC College of Medicine has an AI student-work policy (medicine.uic.edu) but it is not a computing unit. No UIC CS, Engineering or iSchool-type unit policy found in searches. Recheck (D36) added: illinois-chicago-cs-grad-2025, illinois-chicago-cs-grad-2023.
